conditional_checks.check: Multi-agency feed requires an agency ID for each agency
Route requires a short or long name
Stops, stations and entrances require names
Timeframe endpoints must be provided together
Populated timeframe start must precede its end
Attribution scope must select at most one of agency, route and trip
Attribution requires a producer, operator or authority role
Type 2 transfers require minimum transfer time
from trip and route must describe the same service
to trip and route must describe the same service
Mutually specified leg groups constrain transfer_count
Duration limit and duration type must be provided together
Route and direction pair has no matching scheduled trip
